newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sa Sa Int'l ends debut sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: Sa Sa Int'l ends debut sharply higher.

text.p: Shares of cosmetics retailer Sa Sa International Holdings Ltd ended its debut higher in overall volatile trade on Friday.
The company shares ended at HK$3.65 per share on Friday, up 53.36 percent to their issue price of HK$2.38 each. The shares moved in range of HK$2.80 to HK$3.75.
Volume was 246.57 million shares worth HK$822.31 million.
"It performed satisfactorily. People were seen convinced by its earnings potential," said Pamela Lam, analyst at Pacific Challenge Securities.

Sa Sa offered a total 328 million new shares in global offering. Its Hong Kong public offering portion of 59.04 million shares was about 531 times subscribed and another 6.56 million shares reserved for employees were fully allotted.
Analysts said investors found the stock attractive because of its potentially high earnings growth when the company was involved in the profitable cosmetics business.

"Even though the stock was trading at a relatively high P/E (price to earnings) of about 21 times, it was still at an acceptable level in view of its high growth potential," said Kinson Au, research manager at Asia Financial Securities.

Sa Sa engages in the retail and wholesale of a wide range of cosmetic products including skin-care, make-up, fragrances and hair care products. It operates a chain of 11 retail outlets in Hong Kong and one in Taipei, Taiwan.
Sa Sa had said most of the proceeds raised from the new issue would be used to expand its operation network in Asia.
Analysts said as the first pure cosmetics related stock in the market, it worth to hold in longer term.
